ny_cash_gap_fade_adr.note: Gap = first 09:30 ET open / prior NY-cash close − 1. NOT vs last pre-09:30 print (that jump is ~0 on this CFD). Fade −sign(gap). ADR = mean of last n completed cash-session ranges. Compare |gap|*prior_close >= k*ADR.
ny_cash_gap_fade_adr.entry_note: next_0930 stamps the first cash bar (fill = next M5 open). after_ib stamps first bar open >= 10:30 only if the gap is not already filled (close still on the gap side of prior cash close).

htf_lock_orb.note: 15m OR close-break (not v4 ATR-regime, not frozen AND-gate). Hard-gated by completed-H4 EMA50/200 (BTC grammar) and/or completed ET-day Donchian-20 state. Chop (0) = no trade. Do not fade HTF.
htf_lock_orb.h4: UTC 4h buckets from M5; EMA50/200 on completed H4 closes; +1 iff h4_close>ema200 and ema50>ema200
htf_lock_orb.donch: ET-date H/L; channel = last 20 completed days excluding the last completed day; +1 if that day's close > channel high

exog_us30_ny_cash_cosign_us100_follow.note: Intersection I of FP US100 and US30 M5. T* = first I bar with open >= 09:45 ET. s = sign(US30 close−open) at T* if nonzero. US100 T* bar is not in the predicate. Follow s on US100 at next I bar. Not hours {7,8,9}. Not joint fade. Not v3 divergence.
